The [[Drolan Plasteel]] '''auto-caster''' was a model of [[repeating crossbow]].

An ancient weapon designed for use by [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], the Auto-caster was a repeating crossbow, and was very quiet while retaining excellent aim and precision. Widely regarded as an antique, the Auto-caster nevertheless remained a capable weapon, and modern reproductions were used by some security corporations. Modern reproductions possessed excellent accuracy and stopping power rivaling a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol, making the Auto-caster moderately effective against modern armors.<ref name="JvS">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
